svg.title: Supervised warm-up · logged FIT diagnostics and VALIDATION

cc:Work.dc:title: Supervised warm-up · logged FIT diagnostics and VALIDATION
cc:Work.dc:description: fresh_start_v1 · logged dropout-disabled supervised evaluation, before held-out TEST analysis. OOC soft CE is normalized over CHOICE rows, excluding forced rows. FIT diagnostics use the fixed 128-row subset (choice rows within it). Lines are logged point diagnostics; confidence intervals are not estimated for these logs. Cadence: 100 supervised optimizer steps.

g.text: Supervised warm-up · logged FIT diagnostics and VALIDATION
fresh_start_v1 · logged dropout-disabled supervised evaluation, before held-out TEST analysis.
OOC soft CE is normalized over CHOICE rows, excluding forced rows. FIT diagnostics use the fixed 128-row subset (choice rows within it).
Lines are logged point diagnostics; confidence intervals are not estimated for these logs. Cadence: 100 supervised optimizer steps.
